description:
Send one WhatsApp message from a connected number: text, a knowledge-base file (knowledge_file_id), or an approved template. Exactly one of the three. Text and files only work within 24 hours of the person's last message to that number; otherwise send a template. Set send_at to schedule it. This messages a real person and costs the WhatsApp message fee (Meta also bills template fees to the user's WhatsApp Manager payment method): confirm the recipient and the content with the user before sending.

Requires scope `whatsapp:write`.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key for safe retries. Generated automatically when omitted. Reuse the SAME value when retrying the SAME logical request; never reuse it for a different one.

knowledge_file_id.description: A file from list_knowledge_files that was uploaded with its original kept.

send_at.description: ISO 8601 time to send it, up to 30 days ahead.

language.description: Exactly as in WhatsApp Manager, e.g. en_US.

parameters.description: Values for the body placeholders, in order.

to.description: The recipient, with country code, e.g. +14155550100.

name: send_whatsapp_message
title: Send a WhatsApp message
